entries.summary: remark updated: Bird activity follows two phases: normal activity outside migration season (Phase I), and heavy activity during migration season (Phase II from November 1-February 28 for waterfowl and cranes, and April 15-May 31 for Franklin gulls), so aircrews should be aware of increased bird strike potential at these times.
entries.original: MISC: BASH PHASE I - NML BIRD ACT OUTSIDE MIGRATORY SEASON. PHASE II - HVY BIRD ACT, NML ASSOCIATED WITH MIGRATORY SEASON. PHASE II FM 1 NOV - 28 FEB DUE TO MIGRATORY PATS OF LRG WATERFOWL, SANDHILL CRANES, GRACKLES AND SEVERAL BLACKBIRD SPECIES; PHASE II FM15 APR - 31 MAY FOR FRANKLIN GULL. AIRCREWS SHOULD BE AWARE OF THE INCRD BIRD ACT & BASH POTENTIAL AT THESE TIMES.
